title: Scientific Notation

copy.studentInstructions: Convert between scientific notation and standard form. Answers in each column deliberately share the same leading digits, so check the decimal placement and exponent. Mark the matching answer in the called column.
copy.roomIntro: Convert large numbers and small decimals in both directions. Every answer in each column shares the same coefficient, so students must work out the exponent or decimal placement. M and T ask for standard form; A, H, and O ask for scientific notation.
copy.roomHeading: Small decimals. Big numbers. Clear thinking.
copy.callerHeading: Big or small, find its form.
copy.callerSubtitle: Same leading digits. Different powers of ten. Work out the conversion.
copy.joinIntro: Get your teacher’s code. Let’s convert!
copy.footer: Move the decimal. Find your square.
copy.bankIntro: 38 conversions designed to require decimal-place and exponent reasoning. Every answer within a column shares the same coefficient: M 3.2, A 4.5, T 2, H 6.04, O 1.005. M and T convert scientific notation to standard form; A, H, and O convert standard form to scientific notation. O mixes large and small values with zeros inside the coefficient.
